<!--
#========================================================================
# 08_draxin_analysis_3.Rmd
#
# DRAXIN expression and associated transcriptional programmes across nerve
# categories in the Visium spatial transcriptomic dataset. Nerve-level
# aggregation throughout: the nerve, not the spot, is the statistical unit.
#
# WHAT CHANGED RELATIVE TO 08_draxin_analysis_2
#   1. Tumour-associated nerves are now defined symmetrically: invaded AND
#      non-invaded nerves must both lie in tumour-bearing (Diseased) tissue.
#      Previously invaded nerves carried no tissue requirement, so one invaded
#      nerve in adjacent tissue entered the set. The same restriction is
#      applied to the invaded-only analysis, so every panel uses one definition.
#   2. Signature scores are computed under BOTH z-scoring scopes and both are
#      reported: "all_nerve_spots" (primary) and "within_sample" (sensitivity,
#      genes z-scored within each section so section-level differences cannot
#      enter the scores). Outputs go to scope-specific subfolders and a
#      side-by-side comparison is written at the end.
#   3. Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the three Schwann-cell subtype
#      correlations (previously uncorrected).
#   4. Gene-set overlap between the Hallmark TGFb set and the subtype
#      signatures, and pairwise overlap among all subtype signatures, is
#      quantified and written out, so independence of the correlations and the
#      validity of the BH correction can be checked.
#   5. Assertions that the two invasion annotations agree and that no nerve
#      carries more than one category label.
#
# CORRELATION REPORTING
#   Every correlation is reported three ways (cor_summary):
#     rho               pooled Spearman across all nerves
#     rho_within        Spearman on ranks centred within each section, so only
#                       nerve-to-nerve variation inside a section contributes
#                       (sections with >= MIN_NERVES nerves)
#     patients_positive number of patients with a positive per-patient rho
#   rho_within is the primary statistic: nerves are nested in patients and the
#   pooled p value ignores that nesting.
#
# INPUTS  (INPUT_DIR)
#   Integrated_NMF.rds, DE_SPE_annotaion.csv, RCTD_weights.Rds,
#   1-s2.0-S1535610825002703-mmc3.xlsx  (Chen et al. Table S2 marker sheets)
#
# OUTPUTS (output/08_draxin/)
#   figures/
#     FigureS16A_invaded_DRAXIN_vs_NMF_programs.pdf
#       Figure S16A. DRAXIN against the nerve and tumour NMF programmes,
#       invaded nerves only, coloured by patient.
#     exploratory_DRAXIN_vs_NMF_all_nerve_categories.png
#       The same relationship across all three nerve categories. NOT in
#       the manuscript.
#     all_nerve_spots/Figure6D_DRAXIN_vs_SC_subtype_signatures.pdf
#       Figure 6D. DRAXIN against the three Chen et al. Schwann-cell
#       subtype signatures.
#     all_nerve_spots/FigureS16B_DRAXIN_all_subtype_correlation_ranked.pdf
#       Figure S16B. DRAXIN correlation ranked across every refined
#       Chen et al. subtype.
#     all_nerve_spots/FigureS16C_DRAXIN_vs_Hallmark_TGFB.pdf
#       Figure S16C. DRAXIN against the MSigDB Hallmark TGFb signature.
#     within_sample/robustness_*.pdf
#       The same three panels under the within-section z-scoring scope,
#       as a robustness check. NOT in the manuscript.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" or "robustness_" is not in the
# manuscript.
#   tables/
#     signature_overlap_Hallmark_vs_SC.csv
#     signature_overlap_subtypes_summary.csv
#     signature_overlap_subtypes_pairwise.csv
#     <scope>/DRAXIN_vs_Hallmark_TGFB_correlation.csv
#     <scope>/DRAXIN_vs_SC_subtype_correlations.csv
#     <scope>/DRAXIN_vs_all_subtypes_correlation.csv

# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.

if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROCESSED_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "processed")

# ---- Analysis constants (every threshold used anywhere in this script) ------
MIN_SPOTS        <- 3     # spots required for a nerve to be analysed
MIN_NERVES       <- 3     # nerves required for a section / patient to contribute
                          #   to the within-section and per-patient statistics
MIN_SIG_GENES    <- 3     # detected genes required to score a signature
MIN_HALLMARK     <- 5     # detected genes required for the Hallmark score

# z-scoring scopes. The manuscript reports the primary scope

# rather than the pooled one. The second scope, in which genes are
# z-scored within each section, is run as a robustness check and is

SCOPES           <- c("all_nerve_spots", "within_sample")

NMF_NERVE_COL    <- "nerve"
NMF_TUMOR_COL    <- "mnTumor"

  point_size  = 2,
  point_alpha = 0.85,

  caption_wrap_width = 110,

)

spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

W_df <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "RCTD_weights.Rds"))

# 2. Helper functions

```{r}
keep_genes <- function(x, expr_mat) intersect(x, rownames(expr_mat))

# ---- Correlation summary used for every DRAXIN correlation ------------------
# Nerves are pooled across sections and patients, so a plain Spearman
# correlation can be produced by differences in LEVEL between sections or
# patients (sequencing depth, tissue quality) rather than by a relationship
# within tissue. Reported alongside the pooled value:
#   rho_within        ranks centred within each section (sections with
#                     >= MIN_NERVES nerves), so only nerve-to-nerve variation
#                     inside the same section contributes. PRIMARY statistic.
#   patients_positive number of patients (>= MIN_NERVES nerves) with a positive
#                     per-patient Spearman rho.
cor_summary <- function(df, x, y = "DRAXIN_mean", sample_col = "sample_id",
                        patient_col = "patient_id", min_nerves = MIN_NERVES) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  df <- df[is.finite(df[[x]]) & is.finite(df[[y]]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) < 4)
    return(data.frame(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, rho_within = NA_real_,
                      p_within = NA_real_, patients_positive = NA_character_,
                      n_nerves = nrow(df), n_sections_within = 0L, label = ""))

  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(df[[x]], df[[y]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))

  ns <- table(df[[sample_col]])
  keep_sections <- names(ns)[ns >= min_nerves]
  w  <- df[df[[sample_col]] %in% keep_sections, , drop = FALSE]
  centre_ranks <- function(v, g) {
    r <- ave(v, g, FUN = rank)
    r - ave(r, g, FUN = mean)
  }
  cw <- if (nrow(w) >= 4)
    suppressWarnings(cor.test(centre_ranks(w[[x]], w[[sample_col]]),
                              centre_ranks(w[[y]], w[[sample_col]]))) else NULL

  pp <- sapply(split(df, df[[patient_col]]), function(s)
    if (nrow(s) >= min_nerves)
      suppressWarnings(cor(s[[x]], s[[y]], method = "spearman")) else NA_real_)
  pp <- pp[!is.na(pp)]

  out <- data.frame(
    rho               = unname(ct$estimate),
    p                 = ct$p.value,
    rho_within        = if (is.null(cw)) NA_real_ else unname(cw$estimate),
    p_within          = if (is.null(cw)) NA_real_ else cw$p.value,
    patients_positive = paste0(sum(pp > 0), "/", length(pp)),
    n_nerves          = nrow(df),
    n_sections_within = length(keep_sections)
  )
  out$label <- paste0(
    "Spearman ρ = ", sprintf("%.2f", out$rho), ", p = ", signif(out$p, 2),
    "\nwithin section ρ = ", sprintf("%.2f", out$rho_within),
    ", p = ", signif(out$p_within, 2),
    "; positive in ", out$patients_positive, " patients")
  out
}

# ---- Nerve objects ---------------------------------------------------------
build_nerve_spe <- function(spe_object) {
  nerve_spe <- spe_object[, colData(spe_object)$is.nerve == TRUE]
  nerve_spe$types <- nerve_spe$type
  colData(nerve_spe)$types[colData(nerve_spe)$types == "noPNI"]   <- "Adjacent"
  colData(nerve_spe)$types[colData(nerve_spe)$types != "Adjacent"] <- "Diseased"
  colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types <- ifelse(
    colData(nerve_spe)$Invaded == "NonInvaded",
    paste0(colData(nerve_spe)$Invaded, "_", colData(nerve_spe)$types),
    as.character(colData(nerve_spe)$Invaded))
  nerve_spe[, !is.na(colData(nerve_spe)$nerve_types)]
}

build_nerve_meta <- function(nerve_spe, assay_name = "logcounts") {
  expr <- as.matrix(assay(nerve_spe, assay_name))
  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(nerve_spe))
  stopifnot("DRAXIN" %in% rownames(expr))
  meta$DRAXIN_expr <- as.numeric(expr["DRAXIN", ])
  list(expr = expr, meta = meta)
}

# ---- z-scoring, one function per scope -------------------------------------
# Returns a gene x spot matrix for the tumour-associated spots only. Row names
# are identical in every scope, so gene-set membership does not depend on it.
#   all_nerve_spots    genes z-scored across ALL nerve spots, then subset
#   tumour_associated  genes z-scored across the tumour-associated spots
#   within_sample      genes z-scored separately within each section, so
#                      section-level differences cannot enter the scores
make_z_ta <- function(expr, ta_idx, meta_ta, scope) {
  if (scope == "all_nerve_spots") {
    z <- t(scale(t(expr)))
    z[is.na(z)] <- 0
    z[, ta_idx, drop = FALSE]
  } else if (scope == "tumour_associated") {
    e <- expr[, ta_idx, drop = FALSE]
    z <- t(scale(t(e)))
    z[is.na(z)] <- 0
    z
  } else if (scope == "within_sample") {
    e <- expr[, ta_idx, drop = FALSE]
    z <- e
    for (smp in unique(meta_ta$sample_id)) {
      j  <- which(meta_ta$sample_id == smp)
      zz <- t(scale(t(e[, j, drop = FALSE])))
      zz[is.na(zz)] <- 0
      z[, j] <- zz
    }
    z
  } else {
    stop("Unknown z_scope: ", scope)
  }
}

signature_score <- function(genes, z_ta, min_genes = MIN_SIG_GENES) {
  g <- intersect(setdiff(unique(genes), "DRAXIN"), rownames(z_ta))
  if (length(g) < min_genes) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(z_ta)))
  Matrix::colMeans(z_ta[g, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ---- Scatter plot shared by the Hallmark and subtype-signature panels ------
nerve_scatter <- function(data, score_col, xlab, cor_result, cfg,
                          caption = NULL, legend = "right") {
  lm_layer <- if (isTRUE(cfg$add_lm))
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) else NULL
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[score_col]], y = DRAXIN_mean, colour = nerve_types)) +
    geom_point(alpha = cfg$point_alpha, size = cfg$point_size) +
    lm_layer +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cfg$color_map, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Mean DRAXIN expression (logcounts) per nerve",
         colour = "Nerve type", caption = caption) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = cor_result$label,
             hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.3) +
    theme(plot.margin  = margin(6, 10, cfg$bottom_margin_pt, 10),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0),
          legend.position = legend)
}
```

# 3. Nerve-level objects, with checks

```{r}
nerve_spe  <- build_nerve_spe(spe)
nerve_data <- build_nerve_meta(nerve_spe, assay_name = "logcounts")
expr <- nerve_data$expr
meta <- nerve_data$meta

# No nerve may carry more than one category label.
stopifnot(all(tapply(as.character(meta$nerve_types), as.character(meta$NerveID),
                     function(x) length(unique(x))) == 1))
# The two invasion annotations must agree on the full nerve set.
stopifnot("InvadedNerve" %in% names(meta))
stopifnot(sum(meta$InvadedNerve %in% c(TRUE, 1, "TRUE")) ==
          sum(meta$nerve_types == "Invaded", na.rm = TRUE))

cat("Nerve spots by category and tissue context:\n")
print(table(nerve_types = meta$nerve_types, tissue = meta$types, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r}
# ---- Tumour-associated nerves ----------------------------------------------
# Invaded AND non-invaded nerves must both lie in tumour-bearing tissue, so the
# definition is symmetric. NonInvaded_Diseased already implies Diseased by
# construction, so the tissue condition only constrains the invaded arm.
ta_idx  <- which(meta$nerve_types %in% c("Invaded", "NonInvaded_Diseased") &
                 meta$types == "Diseased")
meta_ta <- meta[ta_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- Invaded-only set, same tissue restriction ----------------------------
inv_idx  <- which(meta$InvadedNerve %in% c(TRUE, 1, "TRUE") & meta$types == "Diseased")
meta_inv <- meta[inv_idx, , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nTumour-associated nerve spots:", length(ta_idx),
    "| invaded-only nerve spots:", length(inv_idx), "\n")
cat("Invaded nerve spots excluded because they lie in adjacent tissue:",
    sum(meta$nerve_types == "Invaded" & meta$types != "Diseased", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

# 4. DRAXIN versus NMF programmes, all nerve categories

These NMF programme scores come from `colData` and are not z-scored, so this
section and the next do not depend on the z-scoring scope.

```{r}
nerve_df <- meta %>%
  group_by(patient_id, sample_id, NerveID, nerve_types) %>%
  summarise(DRAXIN_mean    = mean(DRAXIN_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
            NMF_nerve_mean = mean(.data[[NMF_NERVE_COL]], na.rm = TRUE),
            NMF_tumor_mean = mean(.data[[NMF_TUMOR_COL]], na.rm = TRUE),
            n_spots        = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_spots >= MIN_SPOTS) %>%
  mutate(nerve_types = factor(nerve_types,
           levels = c("Invaded", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "NonInvaded_Adjacent")))

write.csv(as.data.frame(table(nerve_types = nerve_df$nerve_types)),
          file.path(TABLES_DIR, "nerve_counts_by_group.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Nerves analysed per category (>= ", MIN_SPOTS, " spots):\n", sep = "")
print(table(nerve_df$nerve_types))

df_long_all <- nerve_df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(NMF_nerve_mean, NMF_tumor_mean),
               names_to = "program", values_to = "program_score") %>%
  mutate(program = recode(program,
           NMF_nerve_mean = "NMF nerve program",
           NMF_tumor_mean = "NMF tumour program"))

cor_stats_all <- df_long_all %>%
  group_by(program) %>% group_modify(~ cor_summary(.x, "program_score")) %>% ungroup()
print(as.data.frame(cor_stats_all[, setdiff(names(cor_stats_all), "label")]))

p4J_all <- ggplot(df_long_all, aes(program_score, DRAXIN_mean, colour = nerve_types)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ program, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_text(data = cor_stats_all, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.3) +
  labs(x = "Mean NMF program score per nerve",
       y = "Mean DRAXIN expression (logcounts) per nerve", colour = "Nerve type") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))
p4J_all
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_DRAXIN_vs_NMF_all_nerve_categories.png"),
       p4J_all, width = 7, height = 4.2, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

# 6. Gene sets

Scope-independent: the gene sets and their detected membership depend only on
the rows of the expression matrix, which are the same under every scope.

```{r}
# ---- MSigDB Hallmark TGFb signalling --------------------------------------
tgfb_hallmark_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
tgfb_genes_raw <- tgfb_hallmark_df %>%
  filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING") %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>% unique()
# DRAXIN excluded so the correlation cannot be partly DRAXIN with itself.
tgfb_genes <- setdiff(keep_genes(tgfb_genes_raw, expr), "DRAXIN")
cat("Hallmark TGFb genes: ", length(tgfb_genes_raw), " in the set, ",
    length(tgfb_genes), " detected and used\n", sep = "")
stopifnot(length(tgfb_genes) >= MIN_HALLMARK)

hallmark_caption <- str_wrap(paste0(
  "MSigDB Hallmark TGFβ signalling genes used for scoring, DRAXIN excluded: ",
  paste(tgfb_genes, collapse = ", ")), width = plot_cfg$caption_wrap_width)

# ---- Chen et al. Schwann-cell subtype signatures --------------------------
chen_schwann <- read_excel(CHEN_SUPP_TABLE_PATH, sheet = "S2H. Schwann", skip = 1)
sc_sigs <- list(
  TGFBI    = unique(chen_schwann$gene[chen_schwann$cluster == "S02_Schwann-TGFBI"]),
  ABCA8    = unique(chen_schwann$gene[chen_schwann$cluster == "S01_Schwann-ABCA8"]),
  SERPINA3 = unique(chen_schwann$gene[chen_schwann$cluster == "S03_Schwann-SERPINA3"]))
cat("\nDRAXIN present in the subtype marker list (removed if TRUE):\n")
print(sapply(sc_sigs, function(g) "DRAXIN" %in% g))
sc_sigs <- lapply(sc_sigs, function(g) setdiff(g, "DRAXIN"))
sc_sigs_present <- lapply(sc_sigs, function(g) intersect(g, rownames(expr)))
cat("\nSchwann subtype signature coverage (detected / in list):\n")
print(data.frame(signature = names(sc_sigs),
                 detected  = sapply(sc_sigs_present, length),
                 in_list   = sapply(sc_sigs, length),
                 pct = round(100 * sapply(sc_sigs_present, length) /
                                   sapply(sc_sigs, length)), row.names = NULL))

# ---- All refined Chen et al. subtypes -------------------------------------
refined_sheets <- c("S2B. CD4T", "S2C. CD8T", "S2D. B cell", "S2E. Myeloid cell",
                    "S2F. Fibro", "S2G. Ductal", "S2H. Schwann")
all_subtype_markers <- bind_rows(lapply(refined_sheets, function(sh)
  read_excel(CHEN_SUPP_TABLE_PATH, sheet = sh, skip = 1) %>% mutate(source_sheet = sh)))
subtype_gene_lists <- split(all_subtype_markers$gene, all_subtype_markers$cluster)
subtype_sheet <- sapply(names(subtype_gene_lists), function(ct)
  unique(all_subtype_markers$source_sheet[all_subtype_markers$cluster == ct])[1])
cat("\nRefined subtypes in the reference:", length(subtype_gene_lists), "\n")
```

# 7. Gene-set overlap

Quantifies how far the correlated gene sets share genes, so the Hallmark and
subtype-signature correlations can be reported as independent, and so the BH
correction across subtypes can be justified.

```{r}
hallmark_overlap <- data.frame(
  Signature    = names(sc_sigs_present),
  n_genes      = sapply(sc_sigs_present, length),
  n_shared     = sapply(sc_sigs_present, function(g) length(intersect(g, tgfb_genes))),
  shared_genes = sapply(sc_sigs_present, function(g)
                   paste(intersect(g, tgfb_genes), collapse = ", ")),
  row.names = NULL)
hallmark_overlap$pct_shared <-
  round(100 * hallmark_overlap$n_shared / hallmark_overlap$n_genes, 1)
cat("Hallmark TGFb genes used:", length(tgfb_genes), "\n")
print(hallmark_overlap)
write.csv(hallmark_overlap,
          file.path(TABLES_DIR, "signature_overlap_Hallmark_vs_SC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

used_sigs <- lapply(subtype_gene_lists, function(g)
  intersect(setdiff(unique(g), "DRAXIN"), rownames(expr)))
used_sigs <- used_sigs[sapply(used_sigs, length) >= MIN_SIG_GENES]
N_SIG_SCORED <- length(used_sigs)

jaccard <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
M <- outer(seq_along(used_sigs), seq_along(used_sigs),
           Vectorize(function(i, j) jaccard(used_sigs[[i]], used_sigs[[j]])))
dimnames(M) <- list(names(used_sigs), names(used_sigs))
up <- M[upper.tri(M)]

subtype_overlap <- data.frame(
  n_signatures_scored = N_SIG_SCORED,
  genes_per_signature = paste(range(sapply(used_sigs, length)), collapse = "-"),
  jaccard_median      = round(median(up), 3),
  jaccard_p90         = round(unname(quantile(up, 0.9)), 3),
  jaccard_max         = round(max(up), 3),
  pairs_above_0_1     = sum(up > 0.1),
  n_pairs             = length(up))
print(subtype_overlap)
write.csv(subtype_overlap,
          file.path(TABLES_DIR, "signature_overlap_subtypes_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

pairs_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(M), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(pairs_df) <- c("A", "B", "Jaccard")
pairs_df <- pairs_df[pairs_df$A < pairs_df$B & pairs_df$Jaccard > 0, ]
pairs_df <- pairs_df[order(-pairs_df$Jaccard), ]
cat("\nMost overlapping signature pairs:\n"); print(head(pairs_df, 10), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pairs_df,
          file.path(TABLES_DIR, "signature_overlap_subtypes_pairwise.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 8. Signature-based correlations, run under every z-scoring scope

One function, called once per scope. Figures and tables for each scope go to a
subfolder named after it, so neither run overwrites the other.

```{r}
run_scope <- function(scope) {
  tdir <- file.path(TABLES_DIR,  scope)
  fdir <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, scope)
  dir.create(tdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(fdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  cat("\n================ z_scope =", scope, "================\n")

  # The manuscript reports the primary scope (all_nerve_spots), quoting the
  # within-section correlation. The second scope is a robustness check, so
  # its figures carry a "robustness_" prefix rather than a figure number.
  fig_name <- function(x) if (scope == PRIMARY_SCOPE) x else paste0("robustness_", x)

  z_ta <- make_z_ta(expr, ta_idx, meta_ta, scope)
  stopifnot(ncol(z_ta) == nrow(meta_ta))      # column order matches meta_ta rows
  m <- meta_ta                                 # local copy; scores added positionally

  # ---- Hallmark TGFb ------------------------------------------------------
  m$TGFB_HALLMARK_score <- signature_score(tgfb_genes, z_ta, min_genes = MIN_HALLMARK)

  ta_nerve <- m %>%
    group_by(patient_id, sample_id, NerveID, nerve_types) %>%
    summarise(DRAXIN_mean        = mean(DRAXIN_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
              TGFB_HALLMARK_mean = mean(TGFB_HALLMARK_score, na.rm = TRUE),
              mnTumor_mean       = mean(.data[[NMF_TUMOR_COL]], na.rm = TRUE),
              n_spots            = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_spots >= MIN_SPOTS) %>%
    mutate(patient_id  = factor(patient_id),
           nerve_types = factor(nerve_types, levels = names(plot_cfg$color_map)))

  cs_tgfb <- cor_summary(ta_nerve, "TGFB_HALLMARK_mean")
  cat("\nDRAXIN vs Hallmark TGFb, per tumour-associated nerve:\n")
  print(cs_tgfb[, setdiff(names(cs_tgfb), "label")])
  write.csv(cs_tgfb[, setdiff(names(cs_tgfb), "label")],
            file.path(tdir, "DRAXIN_vs_Hallmark_TGFB_correlation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  p_tgfb <- nerve_scatter(
    ta_nerve, "TGFB_HALLMARK_mean",
    "Mean MSigDB Hallmark TGFβ signalling score per tumour-associated nerve (z)",
    cs_tgfb, plot_cfg, caption = hallmark_caption)
  print(p_tgfb)
  ggsave(file.path(fdir, fig_name("FigureS16C_DRAXIN_vs_Hallmark_TGFB.pdf")),
         p_tgfb, width = 6.2, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = 600)

  # ---- Three Schwann-cell subtype signatures -----------------------------
  for (nm in names(sc_sigs_present))
    m[[paste0(nm, "_score")]] <- signature_score(sc_sigs_present[[nm]], z_ta)

  ta_nerve_sc <- m %>%
    group_by(patient_id, sample_id, NerveID, nerve_types) %>%
    summarise(DRAXIN_mean   = mean(DRAXIN_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
              TGFBI_mean    = mean(TGFBI_score, na.rm = TRUE),
              ABCA8_mean    = mean(ABCA8_score, na.rm = TRUE),
              SERPINA3_mean = mean(SERPINA3_score, na.rm = TRUE),
              n_spots       = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_spots >= MIN_SPOTS) %>%
    mutate(patient_id  = factor(patient_id),
           nerve_types = factor(nerve_types, levels = names(plot_cfg$color_map)))

  sc_cols <- c(TGFBI = "TGFBI_mean", ABCA8 = "ABCA8_mean", SERPINA3 = "SERPINA3_mean")
  sc_cor_results <- lapply(names(sc_cols), function(nm)
    cbind(Signature = nm, cor_summary(ta_nerve_sc, sc_cols[[nm]])))
  names(sc_cor_results) <- names(sc_cols)

  # BH correction across the three subtype correlations, both statistics.
  sc_tab <- bind_rows(sc_cor_results)
  sc_tab$padj        <- p.adjust(sc_tab$p,        method = "BH")
  sc_tab$padj_within <- p.adjust(sc_tab$p_within, method = "BH")
  cat("\nDRAXIN vs Schwann-cell subtype signatures (BH across the three):\n")
  print(sc_tab[, c("Signature", "n_nerves", "rho", "p", "padj",
                   "rho_within", "p_within", "padj_within", "patients_positive")])
  write.csv(sc_tab[, setdiff(names(sc_tab), "label")],
            file.path(tdir, "DRAXIN_vs_SC_subtype_correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  sc_panels <- lapply(names(sc_cols), function(nm)
    nerve_scatter(ta_nerve_sc, sc_cols[[nm]],
                  paste0("Mean Schwann-", nm,
                         " signature score\nper tumour-associated nerve (z)"),
                  sc_cor_results[[nm]], plot_cfg, legend = "none"))
  p_sc <- Reduce(`|`, sc_panels) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  print(p_sc)
  ggsave(file.path(fdir, fig_name("Figure6D_DRAXIN_vs_SC_subtype_signatures.pdf")),
         p_sc, width = 13, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = 600)

  # ---- All refined subtypes ----------------------------------------------
  cat("\nScoring", length(subtype_gene_lists), "refined subtypes (slow)...\n")
  score_mat <- sapply(names(subtype_gene_lists), function(ct)
    signature_score(subtype_gene_lists[[ct]], z_ta))
  stopifnot(nrow(score_mat) == nrow(m))
  sub_cols <- paste0("subtype_", colnames(score_mat))
  for (k in seq_along(sub_cols)) m[[sub_cols[k]]] <- score_mat[, k]

  ta_nerve_all <- m %>%
    group_by(patient_id, sample_id, NerveID, nerve_types) %>%
    summarise(DRAXIN_mean = mean(DRAXIN_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
              across(all_of(sub_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
              n_spots = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_spots >= MIN_SPOTS)

  all_cor <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(score_mat), function(ct) {
    col <- paste0("subtype_", ct)
    if (all(is.na(ta_nerve_all[[col]]))) return(NULL)
    cs <- cor_summary(ta_nerve_all, col)
    data.frame(Subtype = ct, source_sheet = subtype_sheet[[ct]],
               rho = cs$rho, p_value = cs$p,
               rho_within_sample = cs$rho_within, p_within_sample = cs$p_within,
               patients_positive = cs$patients_positive, n_nerves = cs$n_nerves)
  }))
  all_cor <- all_cor %>%
    mutate(padj               = p.adjust(p_value,         method = "BH"),
           padj_within_sample = p.adjust(p_within_sample, method = "BH"),
           rank_pooled        = rank(-rho),
           rank_within_sample = rank(-rho_within_sample),
           is_schwann         = grepl("Schwann", Subtype)) %>%
    arrange(desc(rho_within_sample))
  cat("\nSubtypes scored:", nrow(all_cor),
      "| top 10 by within-section rho:\n")
  print(head(all_cor[, c("Subtype", "rho", "padj", "rho_within_sample",
                         "padj_within_sample", "patients_positive")], 10),
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nRanks of the Schwann-cell subtypes (within-section rho):\n")
  print(all_cor[all_cor$is_schwann,
                c("Subtype", "rho_within_sample", "padj_within_sample",
                  "rank_within_sample")], row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(all_cor, file.path(tdir, "DRAXIN_vs_all_subtypes_correlation.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  plot_df <- all_cor %>%
    mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = Subtype[order(rho_within_sample)]))
  p_rank <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(rho_within_sample, Subtype, colour = is_schwann)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D55E00", `FALSE` = "grey50"), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Spearman ρ, DRAXIN vs subtype signature (within section)", y = NULL,
         title = paste0("DRAXIN correlation across ", nrow(all_cor),
                        " refined Chen et al. subtypes"),
         subtitle = paste0("Orange, Schwann-cell subtypes; z-scoring scope: ", scope)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  print(p_rank)
  ggsave(file.path(fdir, fig_name("FigureS16B_DRAXIN_all_subtype_correlation_ranked.pdf")),
         p_rank, width = 10, height = 17.5, dpi = 600)

  list(scope = scope, cs_tgfb = cs_tgfb, sc_tab = sc_tab, all_cor = all_cor,
       ta_nerve = ta_nerve, ta_nerve_sc = ta_nerve_sc, ta_nerve_all = ta_nerve_all)
}

res <- lapply(SCOPES, run_scope)
names(res) <- SCOPES
```

# 9. The two scopes side by side

```{r}
# ---- Hallmark and the three Schwann subtypes ------------------------------
cmp_main <- bind_rows(lapply(SCOPES, function(s) {
  h <- res[[s]]$cs_tgfb
  bind_rows(
    data.frame(z_scope = s, Comparison = "Hallmark TGFb",
               rho = h$rho, p = h$p, padj = NA_real_,
               rho_within = h$rho_within, p_within = h$p_within,
               padj_within = NA_real_,
               patients_positive = h$patients_positive, n_nerves = h$n_nerves),
    data.frame(z_scope = s,
               Comparison = paste0("Schwann-", res[[s]]$sc_tab$Signature),
               rho = res[[s]]$sc_tab$rho, p = res[[s]]$sc_tab$p,
               padj = res[[s]]$sc_tab$padj,
               rho_within = res[[s]]$sc_tab$rho_within,
               p_within = res[[s]]$sc_tab$p_within,
               padj_within = res[[s]]$sc_tab$padj_within,
               patients_positive = res[[s]]$sc_tab$patients_positive,
               n_nerves = res[[s]]$sc_tab$n_nerves))
}))
cmp_main$primary_scope <- cmp_main$z_scope == PRIMARY_SCOPE
print(cmp_main, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cmp_main, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "comparison_Hallmark_and_SC_by_scope.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# ---- All refined subtypes, one row per subtype ----------------------------
cmp_sub <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = c("Subtype", "source_sheet"), all = TRUE),
  lapply(SCOPES, function(s) {
    d <- res[[s]]$all_cor[, c("Subtype", "source_sheet", "rho", "padj",
                              "rho_within_sample", "padj_within_sample",
                              "rank_within_sample")]
    names(d)[3:7] <- paste0(names(d)[3:7], "__", s)
    d
  }))
cmp_sub <- cmp_sub[order(-cmp_sub[[paste0("rho_within_sample__", PRIMARY_SCOPE)]]), ]
write.csv(cmp_sub, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "comparison_all_subtypes_by_scope.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

if (length(SCOPES) == 2) {
  a <- cmp_sub[[paste0("rho_within_sample__", SCOPES[1])]]
  b <- cmp_sub[[paste0("rho_within_sample__", SCOPES[2])]]
  cat("\nAgreement between scopes, within-section rho across subtypes:",
      "Spearman", round(cor(a, b, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3),
      "| Pearson", round(cor(a, b, use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
}
cat("\nSchwann-cell subtypes under both scopes:\n")
print(cmp_sub[grepl("Schwann", cmp_sub$Subtype), ], row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nOutputs written to", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME), "\n")
cat("Primary scope:", PRIMARY_SCOPE,
    "| primary statistic: within-section rho (nerves are nested in patients)\n")
sessionInfo()
```
